attackers_goals: Gain high privileged command execution on the host machine via one of its running containers.
description: A contained executable from a mounted share initiated a suspicious outbound network connection. Running binaries from a mounted share is highly dangerous and not typical.
investigative_actions: Check if the requested IP address is known or malicious. Investigate the contained process and its process tree.
